t: A free Scratch-based coding tool for Makeblock robots, Arduino, and micro:bit with AI blocks.
steps: Open the browser editor at ide.mblock.cc for blocks or python.mblock.cc for Python.
Or install the desktop app on Windows or Mac.
Connect a Makeblock robot or micro:bit for hardware projects.
Use Chrome or Edge for direct Bluetooth or serial links. The page does not mention Chromebooks.
Try one AI block with a short test.
Decide whether students need accounts. Accounts are optional.
